coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Indore GIS is an official city planning and utility map portal; MP Bhulekh is the state land-record portal. No public cadastral parcel layer or target parcel geometry verified in this pass.

technicalBlocker: The official municipal GIS times out before TLS from two networks. Public commercial demo shapes are rotated and shifted into an undocumented private frame, so they are not verified georeferenced parcel geometry.
remainingUncertainty: No public, nonempty parcel polygon associated with the exact WUP target point was verified.
nextStep: Recheck the official municipal WebGIS when reachable, or obtain the publisher’s documented georeferenced public layout feed. The demonstration-coordinate shapes are not a runtime substitute.
